label: AUTHENTIC mainnet data (trie nodes from mainnet state sync, receipts/blocks from RPC); see anchors and not_anchored

pre_state.meaning: prev_state_root of sync_prev.chunks[shard]: the shard state after the previous new chunk
pre_state.parts_not_committed: the raw parts (7-20 MB each) are not committed; apply_witness.bin holds every node Runtime::apply read, each hash-linked to state_root

receipt_from_transaction:8YkKjjgSbemup7x.meaning: receipt is the conversion receipt of a Transfer transaction (tx outcome receipt_ids == [id], same signer/receiver/key/actions), hence Receipt::from_tx => ReceiptEnum::Action (in v1 domain); RPC ReceiptView -> Receipt conversion is then exact

protocol_version_86.meaning: EXPERIMENTAL_protocol_config at the execution block: protocol_version 86, chain_id mainnet

state_header_root_matches_chain.meaning: sha256 of the peer-served state root node == chunk header prev_state_root of sync_prev.chunks[shard] (from RPC) == pre_state_root

claim_pre_state_root_is_execution_chunk_.meaning: claim.pre_state_root == prev_state_root of the chunk that actually executed the receipts

onchain_outcome_proof:8YkKjjgSbemup7xoen.meaning: on-chain outcome (RPC) + its merkle path hash to the execution chunk's outcome root, committed as prev_outcome_root in the next chunk header

claim_outcome_root_equals_onchain_outcom.meaning: batch of 1: claim.outcome_root (oracle) == the on-chain outcome leaf of that receipt (state-independent outputs: refund id, gas, tokens, status)

execution_chunk_contains_exactly_the_bat.meaning: next chunk header prev_gas_used == claim.gas_burnt_total and prev_balance_burnt == claim.tokens_burnt_total (the execution chunk burnt exactly the batch's gas)

claim_outcome_root_equals_onchain_prev_o.meaning: claim.outcome_root == next chunk header prev_outcome_root (only possible when the chunk executed exactly the batch)

refunds_match_onchain_outgoing_receipts.meaning: the gas refunds the claim commits to (receiver, amount, count) are the execution chunk's on-chain outgoing receipts with the on-chain refund ids

receiver_records_identical_to_execution_.meaning: each receiver's Account record under pre_state_root (from the authentic witness) equals view_account at the execution block's prev block, so the slice computes the same per-receipt account write the chain made

not_anchored: slice_post_root (projection root, never on chain; spec §5)

pre_state_root is an on-chain root of the same shard but from an EARLIER chunk (height 218303536) than the one that executed the receipts (height 218303595); the chain applied the receipts to a different state root, so the claim is a replay of authentic receipts against an authentic earlier state, not the chain's own transition
excluded_by_spec: block finality, receipt inclusion proofs, signatures: spec/claim-v1.md §6 (external trust)
